description: Check real-time availability for one date. Returns the open start times in 24-hour HH:MM (Reykjavik time), the session length for the party, a pre-filled booking URL and the price. An empty list means the date is fully booked or the studio is closed, not an error. The price is 16 000 ISK per person, charged in ISK.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code (EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, CNY) shown as an approximate reference beside the price. The price itself is in ISK and is charged in ISK. Unknown codes are ignored.

date.description: Date to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Today or later, within 548 days.

participants.description: Number of people in the session (1-20; more than 8 are arranged with the studio). Defaults to 1.

name: check_availability
title: Check booking availability
